title: WHO List Title
body:
Syntax: title <words> | title set <words> | title color <name|0-255> | title clear

Sets or REPLACES the existing title immediately; you NEVER need TITLE CLEAR first. TITLE CLEAR is only for removing a title entirely.

The title is displayed after your character name ONLY in WHO, including its linkdead list. It never appears in OOC, CHATLOG, WHOIS, SCORE, LOOK, emotes, combat or other displays.

Multiple colors can be used in one title with built-in MUD codes:
  title &RFlame &CIce &YMaster
  title &[208]Orange &[39]Blue
  title color gold
The TITLE COLOR command sets the default color; inline color codes override it for individual portions of the title. Example: Sasuke [Flame Ice Master], with separately colored words.

Titles allow up to 40 VISIBLE characters plus up to 16 valid inline color codes (no raw terminal/control escapes). Named title colors include red, green, yellow, blue, cyan, magenta, purple, white, gray, orange, pink, gold, or xterm 0-255.
Your character name, account name and targeting remain unchanged. Titles and their colors save immediately and persist through relogs/reboots.
